title: Equestria OS Disk Manager
fmt_warn: WARNING: All data will be ERASED!
confirm_fmt:
FORMAT /dev/{dev}?

All data will be PERMANENTLY ERASED.
This cannot be undone!
tt_disk: Select the physical drive or partition to configure
tt_mount: Absolute path where the drive will be mounted
tt_opts: Mount options for /etc/fstab. You can edit these manually.
tt_auto: Write this drive to /etc/fstab so it mounts on boot
tt_user: Select the system user who will own this drive
tt_perms: Change directory owner and grant read/write access
tt_rec: Apply permissions to all nested folders and files (may take time)
tt_mount_now: Mount the partition to the path specified above
tt_format: Format with a new filesystem — ERASES ALL DATA
fstab_orphan_hint:
These /etc/fstab entries have no matching connected disk.
Without 'nofail' they may block system boot.
fstab_orphan_warn: Disk not connected — may block boot
fmt_rm_fstab_note: (The existing fstab entry for this partition will be removed automatically)
warn_empty_mount: Mount point and options cannot be empty!
tt_save_fstab: Update mount point and options in /etc/fstab
tt_open_fstab: Open /etc/fstab in a text editor to inspect or hand-edit it directly
no_editor_found: No text editor or terminal emulator found to open fstab
confirm_type_hint: Type the partition name ({dev}) to confirm:
warn_label_len: Label is too long for {fs} — maximum {max} characters
warn_fat16_size: FAT16 supports volumes up to 4 GiB only — use FAT32 or exFAT
warn_label_chars: FAT/exFAT label: only letters, digits, space, '_', '.', '-'
fmt_keep_fstab_note: (UUID will be kept — the existing fstab entry stays valid)
tt_keep_uuid: Create the new filesystem with the same UUID so /etc/fstab and other references keep working. Available when the new filesystem is the same family as the current one.
fs_desc_ext4: Linux standard — fast and reliable; best choice for internal drives
fs_desc_btrfs: Modern Linux FS with snapshots and transparent compression
fs_desc_ntfs: Windows filesystem; use for drives shared with Windows
fs_desc_exfat: Flash drives and cross-OS exchange; no Linux permissions
fs_desc_fat32: Maximum compatibility; single file up to 4 GB
fs_desc_fat16: Legacy devices (cameras, MP3 players, embedded); volume up to 4 GiB
fs_desc_ext3: Older ext generation — only for compatibility with old systems
fs_desc_ext2: Legacy ext without journal — loses data on power failure
confirm_del_part:
DELETE partition /dev/{dev}?

All data on this partition will be PERMANENTLY LOST!
confirm_new_table:
Create a new {type} partition table on /dev/{disk}?

EVERY partition and ALL data on the ENTIRE disk will be destroyed!
confirm_rm_net:
Remove network drive {src}?

Data on the server is NOT affected — only the connection is removed.
net_hint: The drive is mounted into a real folder visible to ALL apps (not only Dolphin). It connects on first access; boot never hangs if the server is off.
shrink_warn: Shrinking moves the filesystem boundary — back up important data first!
no_pt: No partition table — create one to use this disk
tt_pro: Show advanced partitioning tools for experienced users
resize_na: Resize is not available for this filesystem
opt_tip.noatime: Don't update file access time — improves disk performance
opt_tip.nofail: Don't fail boot if the drive is missing or unavailable
opt_tip.exec:
Explicitly allow executing binaries.
Use this to override 'noexec' from an old fstab entry.
Not needed if noexec is not set — exec is the default.
opt_tip.noexec:
Prevent execution of any binaries on this partition.
⚠ Don't enable for Steam game drives!
opt_tip.noauto: Don't auto-mount when 'mount -a' runs — mount manually only
opt_tip.uid:
User ID that owns all files on this drive.
Find yours in terminal: id -u
opt_tip.gid:
Group ID that owns all files on this drive.
Find yours in terminal: id -g
opt_tip.fmask:
Permission mask for files.
022  →  rwxr-xr-x  ← use this for Steam/games
133  →  rw-r--r--  ← use this for documents only
opt_tip.winnames:
Restrict filenames to Windows-compatible characters.
⚠ DO NOT use for Steam game libraries — breaks game files!
opt_tip.compress:
Transparent compression algorithm.
zstd = best speed/ratio on modern CPUs
